name: crabs-video-platform-p2p
description: P2P video platform demo using crabs-wasm

scripts.build:client: esbuild client.js --bundle --outfile=public/client_bundle.js --format=iife --global-name=CRABSClient --platform=browser --external:path --external:fs && cp ../../bindings/wasm/crabs.dev.js public/crabs.dev.js && cp ../../bindings/wasm/crabs.dev.wasm public/crabs.dev.wasm
scripts.test:browser: npm run build:client && npx playwright test
